derivation: apparently from the same as H5553 (סֶלַע) in the sense of crushing as with a rock, i.e. consuming;
def: a kind of locust (from its destructiveness)

occurrences.text: Even these of them ye may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.
